name: Pair
briefing: Slide the remaining card next to its twin to make a pair.

name: Two Pair
briefing: Place both cards to complete two pairs in the same line.

name: Three of a Kind
briefing: Drop the last Jack to finish three of a kind.

name: Straight
briefing: Fill the gaps so the run becomes a straight.

name: Flush
briefing: Place the club so five clubs sit in one line.

name: Full House
briefing: Complete the three-and-a-pair to make a full house.

name: Four of a Kind
briefing: Add the last matching rank for four of a kind.

name: Straight Flush
briefing: Fill the missing clubs to make a straight flush.

name: Royal Flush
briefing: Place the last hearts to complete the royal flush.
